name: latentscore-clap-benchmark
description:
latentscore CLAP Benchmark: Config Generation Evaluation
	

Automated evaluation of 6 different approaches for generating music synthesis
configurations from free-text "vibe" descriptions, scored using
CLAP (Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining).
Part of the latentscore project — a
text-to-ambient-music synthesis system that converts vibe descriptions into audio
via parameterized music configs.

	
		
	
	
		What This Dataset Contains
	

Given a vibe like "systematic terror… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/guprab/latentscore-clap-benchmark.
evaluation_method: CLAP similarity score (contrastive language–audio similarity used as automated quality metric)
general_score_metric: CLAP similarity score (contrastive similarity between generated audio and text prompt)
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face as part of the latentscore project; a niche but useful automated benchmark for text-to-audio/config generation research.
